Moves
blackletter accent, superfamily pair
Mood
old, crafted, dark, proud
Case
Blackletter never in capitals (gothic capitals stacked are unreadable); the name in title case, labels in tracked capitals in the text cut.
Numerals and features

Signature
A blackletter name with its own plain sibling: the display and the text are two cuts of one design, so the heritage voice continues into readable sentences.
Use when
Breweries, butchers, tattoo studios, metal and folk music, heritage food brands.
Turns into slop when
When the blackletter sets anything but a name or a single word, when it is used in all capitals, or when it is paired with parchment and wax-seal props.
